emily (CS Lead): Quick heads-up: BrightLeaf submitted a formal SLO reconciliation request. They flagged two latency incidents (Mar 5 & Mar 19) and are asking for a provisional credit. Can we assemble the evidence + credit calc by EOD Fri? @diego @ben
diego (SRE): I can pull traces and the infra timeline. Preliminary notes: Mar 5 looks like a cache warmup + routing rule misfire causing a high miss rate; Mar 19 a downstream DB throttle that lasted ~11m. I have trace IDs: trace-8a3c9f and trace-bf2d11.
neha (AE): Contract excerpt: monthly uptime SLO = 99.8%, p95 latency target = 200ms. Customer is quoting p95=240ms for Mar19 and asking for a 10% service credit.
ben (Data Eng): I'll export the metrics. Example CSV extract I plan to include:
```
period,region,uptime,p95_ms,p99_ms,requests
2024-03-01_to_2024-03-31,global,99.842,145,410,987654
2024-03-19,us-east-1,99.600,240,520,45_123
2024-03-05,us-west-2,99.720,210,480,58_901
```
cara (CSM): Enablement note: we ran three onboarding sessions (Feb 25, Mar 4, Mar 14). Adoption percentage first week: 42%. I'll attach attendance CSV and the config checklist they missed that contributed to routing behavior.
diego (SRE): Also capturing fallback routing stats: during Mar19 spike ~9% of traffic shifted to Dedicated pool, and 11% retried at the edge. I'll include circuit-breaker logs and the auto-scale timeline.
emily (CS Lead): Two deliverables: (A) evidence bundle (metrics CSV, traces, tracer snippets, enablement attendance, rollout notes), (B) customer-facing reconciliation note explaining root causes + credit math.
ben (Data Eng): On credit math — the contract uses monthly uptime shortfall * monthly subscription as baseline. We have an internal rule (v2) that scales latency breaches into credit only if uptime also breached or if p95 > target for > 30m. sla-bot, pull the calc rule?
sla-bot: Credit rule v2 invoked. Formula: 
credit = "max(0, floor(((SLO_value - observed_value)/SLO_value) * monthly_fee * credit_factor))"
credit_factor applied for latency-only events = 0.25, for uptime breaches = 1.0.
neha (AE): Based on that, Mar19 latency-only shortfall => observed p95 240 vs 200 => relative delta = 0.20 => applying factor 0.25 produces ~5% of monthly_fee. Customer's requested 10% is double. Recommend we offer 50% of requested credit (i.e., 5%).
emily (CS Lead): Good call. Also include an appendix with sampling methodology — ben, please say how p95/p99 were computed (edge-rounded requests, dedup retries, retention window).
ben (Data Eng): Sampling note: full edge sample used across all regions; retries deduped by request_id; p95 computed on raw latencies, p99 computed with tail-trim (exclude top 0.05% noisy outliers) — will document rationale.
diego (SRE): Rollout/mitigation notes: we applied a routing rule fix at 2024-03-05T03:22Z (engineer: @tara), and throttling mitigation + hotfix at 2024-03-19T14:08Z (engineer: @mike). I'll export the ops playbook excerpt: /ops/brightleaf/2024/mar-rollbacks.log
emily (CS Lead): I'll draft the reconciliation letter: summary, timeline, evidence links, credit calculation table, recommended offer (5% credit or two weeks free premium support).
cara (CSM): I'll prep the customer slides and include the enablement follow-up plan (targeted config review + extra onboarding session).
neha (AE): We should be prepared for negotiation; offering a small credit + 1 custom enablement session usually closes renewals faster.
emily (CS Lead): Meeting to review packet: Thu 09:00 PT, 30 min. Action items: ben -> CSV + sampling paragraph by Wed 18:00 PT; diego -> traces + ops timeline by Thu 07:30 PT; cara -> slides + attendance CSV by Thu 08:30 PT; neha -> contract clause + negotiation fallback options. I'll finalize cover note.
sla-bot: Evidence snapshot uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/brightleaf/evidence/mar2024_snapshot_v3.zip
emily (CS Lead): Thanks team. If anything changes ping me direct. I'll send the final reconciliation to BrightLeaf after we align on Thursday. :white_check_mark:
